notes.text: CCNL signed 08/05/2025, valid 01/01/2025-31/12/2027 (Federbeton+FILLEA-CGIL+FILCA-CISL+FENEAL-UIL). Source: official PDF 248 pages.
SPLIT model: paga base (Art. 44) + contingenza frozen Nov 1991 (Art. 45) + EDR 10.33 EUR all levels. Three separate components; only paga base changes at each tranche.

PRE-RENEWAL RECOVERY: a +120 EUR recovery (at param 140 reference) was granted in Dec 2024, prior to the May 2025 renewal. The 31/12/2024 column already includes this recovery. Engine models from this base forward.

TRANCHE AMOUNTS (Art. 44): increases proportional to param indices. Reference param=140 (AS3): +60 EUR (01/10/2025), +60 EUR (01/10/2026), +55 EUR (01/10/2027). All-level amounts confirmed from the PDF.
AREA DIRETTIVA 3 (AD3, Quadro): indennita di funzione +41.32 EUR/month (Art. 15). Modelled as INDENNITA_FUNZIONE fixed allowance, months_per_year=13.
AREA ESECUTIVA 1 (AE1): superminimum collettivo di gruppo +7.75 EUR/month treated as paga base for contractual purposes (Art. 44). Added to paga base values in this file.
SENIORITY (Art. 48): 5 biennali (24-month) scatti. Per-level EUR amounts confirmed from Art. 48 of the PDF.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: COMPORTO OF SEVERAL ILLNESSES (art. 55, PDF p. 148-149, https://www.fenealuil.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/CEMENTO_STAMPA-CCNL_2025-NO-UGL.pdf, sha256 0577ad1f914031470abf63b59ffc33b0eff779311bbe10fe670a28b3b0823f97): 'il lavoratore non in prova ha diritto alla conservazione del posto per un periodo complessivo di 14 mesi di calendario, raggiunti anche con più periodi di assenza, nell'ambito dei 30 mesi di calendario immediatamente precedenti.' Modelled as sickness_rules.comporto_windows: 426 days within the 30 months before the day; 14 months as 426 days (x 365/12).

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 49 - Tredicesima mensilita' o gratifica natalizia (p. 141): "Agli effetti di cui sopra la frazione di mese non superiore a 15 giorni non va considerata, mentre va considerata come mese intero la frazione di mese superiore ai 15 giorni.". Match: more_than 15.

reviews.scope: The notice clause (Art. 76, Preavviso di licenziamento e di dimissioni, p. 184-185).
findings: Notice bands by level and service checked against the PDF by a separate session (delegated search and independent verification): work_rules.notice.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 69 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 4 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Comporto of several illnesses, against the research of a separate model session; quote checked on the source text.
findings: Added the comporto window of the CCNL.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.quote: La durata massima del periodo di apprendistato e la sua suddivisione in periodi è così determinata. [...] nel primo periodo di apprendistato professionalizzante: due livelli sotto quello di destinazione finale con retribuzione corrispondente a quella minima contrattuale (minimo tabellare, ex indennità di contingenza e EDR) del livello iniziale di inquadramento; nel secondo periodo: un livello sotto quello di destinazione finale [...]; nel terzo e ultimo periodo: fermo l’inquadramento di cui al secondo periodo di apprendistato, la retribuzione sarà corrispondente a quella prevista per il livello di destinazione finale.

provenance.transformation: Area qualificata 2° livello and Area specialistica 1° livello: 24 months, 12 at two levels below the destination and 12 at one level below, with the pay of that level (minimo, ex contingenza and EDR). Read on the rendered table of p. 61.

provenance.transformation: Bands proposed by a delegated search and checked band by band against the PDF by a separate session. The resignation bands are left out where halving gives a fraction of a month (the engine computes only the indemnity the employer owes on a dismissal); a start day the text does not set is read as the day after the notice; the ratei of the extra months and the TFR treatment are set only where the text states them.
